original_local_details: R6-LOCAL-BERTH-DUTY is an original public landing function; it is not a recruited character, engineering work team or final policy vote.

The chart binds the same actual GLIMMER to Q504's typed OldCityHandover, real rescued_alive_directly_verified Mara state, separate design/policy/execution responsibility findings, current TWR-R5 configuration and its selected bounded custody/publication.

Issuance requires the actual R5 berth, three current registered cabins, physical HUB-S02 chart stand and paired safe R6-S01 public route. No weather, tide, distance or fictional sailing task is added.
Public landing does not produce six upgraded towers, technical verification, engineering supply, jointly signed protocol, checkpoint seal, final departure, combat result, policy decision or reward.
Rook's recorded refusal and move into the seventh tower remain unchanged; public landing is not detention, surrender or final resolution.
